name: etl-ships-a-loadable-map
note: An ET: Legacy map that has been loaded in etlded and played: two sealed rooms, one active spawn per team with its own team_WOLF_objective, a script_multiplayer whose game_manager sets respawn times and autospawns, a func_explosive the script destroys, a player clip pillar and an intermission point. It must validate clean under the ET profile; with --compile it must compile, pack with its script and arena inside and nothing the base game already ships, and pass the pre-ship check. Last, the pk3 is loaded in ET: Legacy itself, server and client, the client joining as a spectator. The base-game half of the pk3 check and the engine load need NRC_FS_BASEPATH and an installed game, and skip without them.
